source_findings.fast_path: FindImage calls equal-address/equal-size/equal-extent resources a perfect match even when their types differ if size is 1x1x1. That bypasses existing equal-span 2D/3D overlap recreation and permits an unsupported sampled view of cached 3D storage.
source_findings.descriptor_trace: ImageInfo takes the guest base image type; ImageViewInfo takes the guest view type. The actual runtime descriptor is sampled 2D while its recorded backing is 3D. This is consistent with the reproduced perfect-match type confusion, not proof that every future incompatible-view case is covered.
source_findings.existing_recreation: ResolveOverlap already routes equal-address/equal-guest-size resources involving Color3D through ExpandImage. ExpandImage creates the requested type, refreshes current CPU data, copies authoritative GPU data when present, marks bound sources for rebind and retires the old image through existing deferred deletion. Runtime::CopyImage already has 3D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D paths; their implementation is unchanged.
